title: IPIP Sympathy — 10 items
source: International Personality Item Pool, preliminary NEO-like facet A6: Sympathy. IPIP item set, not the proprietary NEO-PI-R instrument.
license: Public domain; commercial and non-commercial use permitted by IPIP.
limitations: Self-description responses only, not evidence of experienced empathy or compassionate behavior. Overlaps with other IPIP scales.
instruction: Indicate how accurately the following statement describes you as you generally are now. Respond as yourself, not as a fictional character. Each statement completes: I...

items.text: Feel sympathy for those who are worse off than myself.
Am not interested in other people's problems.
Believe in an eye for an eye.
Try not to think about the needy.
Believe people should fend for themselves.
